steps.label: Dry tomato with towel
steps.recipe_text: dry-gently dry it with a paper/tea towel

steps.label: Slice tomato into thick slices
steps.recipe_text: Slice-Slice one tomato into about 1/2 inch thick slices

steps.label: Place tomato slices on platter
steps.recipe_text: Place-Place the thick slices of tomatoes on a platter, ensuring they only make a single layer

steps.label: Season tomatoes with salt
steps.recipe_text: Season-Season the tomato slices with salt

steps.label: Season platter with pepper
steps.recipe_text: Season-Season platter with 1/4 teaspoon black pepper

steps.label: Sprinkle mozzarella on tomatoes
steps.recipe_text: Sprinkle-Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of the tomato throughout the platter

steps.label: Drizzle olive oil over platter
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil, about 1 tablespoon, over the entire platter
